score_instructions: How interested is this reader in this Item, judged on its own and against no other Item?

derivative.instructions: This Item is a derivative artefact rather than original work. A derivative artefact is a re-upload, a quantisation or GGUF or AWQ or GPTQ or FP8 conversion, a LoRA, a fork, a desktop wrapper or web UI, a plugin, a mirror, or a curated list of such things. A new method, original research, a new tool, or a first-hand report of somebody running a model is NOT a derivative artefact.

marketing.instructions: This Item is business or money news, marketing, a product launch or pricing change, a funding or acquisition story, a leaderboard presented as news, or content-farm slop, rather than technical work.

benchmark.instructions: This Item is primarily a benchmark, an evaluation suite, a leaderboard, or a systematic evaluation of existing systems, rather than a new finding or a new capability.
